event.text: Call 911 now for emergency assessment — do not wait or drive yourself. If emergency help has already been called, stay with that response and follow the dispatcher's instructions. New bladder control trouble with numbness between your legs after a back injury can mean nerve compression at the base of the spine, which needs emergency imaging and specialist assessment today. Tell responders and triage about the bladder symptoms and numbness immediately.
